title: Generative AI Research & Strategy Lead
jobDescription:
Focus: Staying on the bleeding edge and ensuring the team is using the best possible models and techniques. Role Overview: The landscape of Generative AI changes weekly. You are the team’s scout. You evaluate new models, test emerging research papers, and determine which technologies are worth the team’s investment. Job

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Conduct rapid “proof-of-concept” tests on new open-source and closed-source models. Lead prompt engineering efforts and fine-tuning strategies to maximize model performance for specific use cases. Educate the broader Tech Accelerators team on the latest breakthroughs in multimodal AI, long context windows, and reasoning models. Requirements: Strong theoretical understanding of Transformers, Diffusion models, and fine-tuning techniques (Lo RA, QLo RA). Ability to translate “research-speak” into actionable business strategy. Passionate about the AI ecosystem – you spend your weekends reading Ar Xiv papers and testing Git Hub repos. Experience: From fresh graduates to experienced professionals

title: AI Automation & Workflow Architect
jobDescription:
Focus: Identifying and automating complex business processes using agentic workflows. Role Overview: You are a master of efficiency. Your goal is to look at manual, multi-step processes and replace them with autonomous AI agents. You do not just build bots; you build systems that “think” and execute. Job

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design and deploy agentic workflows using tools like Crew AI, Auto Gen, or custom-built Python scripts. Integrate AI agents with existing enterprise software (ERPs, CRMs, and communication tools) via APIs and webhooks. Monitor agent performance and “hallucination rates,” constantly refining prompts and logic for higher accuracy. Requirements: Strong background in systems integration and API management. Experience with workflow automation platforms and low-code/no-code AI tools. Proven ability to deconstruct complex human tasks into machine-executable logic. Experience: From fresh graduates to experienced professionals

title: Full-Stack AI Engineer
jobDescription:
Focus: Building the bridge between LLM capabilities and production-grade applications. Role Overview: The Full-Stack AI Engineer is responsible for the end-to-end development of internal tools and client-facing AI features. You will not just “call an API”; you will design the architecture that makes AI useful, reliable, and fast. Job

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop and maintain robust web applications that integrate seamlessly with various LLMs and Vector Databases. Implement advanced RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines to ground AI outputs in proprietary data. Optimize front-end interfaces for “AI-first” user experiences – ensuring low latency and intuitive human-AI interaction. Requirements: Expertise in modern frameworks (e.g., React, Next.js) and backend languages (Python, Node.js). Deep familiarity with AI orchestration frameworks like Lang Chain, Llama Index, or Haystack. An “AI-Pilled” mindset – you use AI to write, test, and debug your code to achieve 10x productivity. Experience: From fresh graduates to experienced professionals

title: Senior Analyst – Commodity Price Forecasting
jobDescription:
Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled Analyst/Senior Analyst with expertise in commodity price forecasting to join our Research team. The individual will be responsible for building statistical models for commodities, preparing price forecast reports and delivering accurate, data-driven insights. This role involves working with client procurement teams, as well as Beroe’s internal teams, to ensure high-quality, timely delivery of customized forecasting solutions. Job

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop and maintain robust forecasting models for commodities and price indices using econometric techniques, market trends, and historical data Monitor global commodity markets, supply-demand dynamics, and macroeconomic indicators impacting price movements In depth understanding of commodities markets across categories such as petro-chemicals, solvents, agro, metals, etc. Build and validate cost breakdown models for critical categories to identify cost drivers and assess volatility risks. Deliver clear, concise reports and dashboards summarizing commodity price outlook, inflation trends, and cost structure insights. Technical Skills: Strong knowledge of Statistical Data Analysis, Forecasting and Statistical Modelling (Multiple Linear Regression, VAR modelling, Logistic Regression, Factor analysis and Time Series Analysis). Experience in design and development of complex statistical models and build hypothesis on the commodity data and test for validity. Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel. Qualifications & Skills: Master’s degree in economics, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field. 3 – 6 years of experience in commodity price forecasting, inflation analysis, or cost modeling Experience in building time-series and econometric models using R/Python Excellent client-facing communication and stakeholder management skills Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a detail-oriented approach Ability to manage multiple projects and deliver under tight timelines

title: Analyst- Category Specialization
jobDescription:
Reporting To: Team Lead – Technology Job

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Conduct primary and secondary research on IT & Telecom categories, sub-domains, vendor landscapes, and technology trends. Analyze supply, demand, cost structures, and pricing dynamics across IT products and services globally. Build and maintain market models, forecasts, and cost benchmarks (e.g., IT billing rates, pricing models, TCO). Identify, evaluate, and benchmark leading and emerging IT suppliers across regions and service lines. Assess vendor capabilities, sourcing models, innovation, and competitiveness using strategic frameworks (e.g., SWOT, Porter’s Five Forces). Track and synthesize macroeconomic, regulatory, ESG, and geopolitical developments impacting IT procurement. Map value chains, supply chain risks, and adoption trends across IT domains (e.g., cloud, data centers, networking, software, telecom). Liaise with industry experts and validate findings through interviews, surveys, and market engagements. Deliver actionable insights and recommendations to support IT Category Managers in sourcing and negotiation strategies. Provide procurement stakeholders with best practices, sourcing levers, and negotiation benchmarks. Support development of price forecasts and cost models with quantitative and qualitative inputs. Prepare executive-ready reports, dashboards, and presentations highlighting procurement and market implications. Maintain structured databases and knowledge repositories of suppliers, pricing, and market intelligence. Collaborate with internal teams to define new research requirements and enhance category playbooks. Continuously monitor emerging technologies, supplier strategies, and disruptive market shifts to keep insights current.

Perform financial risk assessments, supply chain risk analysis, and country risk analysis Analyze company financial statements using both quantitative and qualitative frameworks Develop detailed risk reports and insights Conduct in-depth risk analysis across the pharmaceutical value chain Execute primary research for financial and supply chain assessments Collaborate with internal stakeholders and build expert networks within the domain Required Skills & Experience: Strong understanding of financial statements and risk concepts Knowledge of supply chain and financial analysis frameworks Experience in the pharmaceutical industry is an added advantage Excellent verbal and written communication skills Strong command of Microsoft Office tools and business writing Ability to work independently and meet close deadlines Education & Experience: UG / MBA / PGDM in Finance / Marketing / Operations / Supply Chain (minimum 60% from Class X onwards) Work Experience : 1–4 years of experience in finance, pharma, or supply chain environments

title: Commodity Forecast Leader
jobDescription:
Job Summary: We are seeking an accomplished Senior Manager/Associate Director to lead and scale our Commodity Price Forecasting function. This leader will oversee a 12–15-member team responsible for developing price forecasts across multiple commodities, regions, and categories. The role demands strong forecasting expertise, deep commodity market insights, and proven leadership experience. This individual will own the end‑to‑end forecasting program including methodology, governance, delivery cadence, stakeholder alignment, and team capability development. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Team Leadership Lead and mentor a team of 12–15 analysts responsible for multi‑region, multi‑category price forecasting Establish team structure, coverage allocation, and workload balancing across commodities and regions. Build team capabilities in forecasting techniques, commodity fundamentals, automation, stakeholder communication, and analytical insights Drive a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and high performance Governance & Delivery : Oversee the end‑to‑end forecasting program including planning, prioritization, delivery governance, and quality assurance Ensure the accuracy, timeliness, explainability, and reliability of all forecasting outputs Implement rigorous quality standards including back‑testing, error tracking (MAPE), and frequent model recalibration. Introduce and scale automation for data ingestion, validation, model refresh, and reporting to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort Standardize data pipelines, templates, and reporting formats to efficiently manage forecasts across 500+commodity indices Commodity Forecasting Expertise Develop and refine forecasting methodologies using time‑series models, econometrics, machine learning, driver models, and scenario frameworks Ensure that all models are auditable, transparent, and supported by clear assumptions and confidence ranges Provide deep subject matter expertise on commodity dynamics including supply‑demand drivers, benchmarks, and market trends Analyze market price and convert them into decision-ready insights—summarizing the observed change in prices, explaining the reasons behind it, highlighting its impact on the business, and presenting forward-looking scenarios Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary liaison between client teams and internal Beroe teams for all commodity price forecasting requirements Lead alignment discussions, governance forums, and conflict‑resolution meetings Influence adoption of forecasting outputs and guide stakeholders toward data‑driven decision‑making Qualifications & Skills: Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Accounting, or related field 12–15+ years of experience in commodity forecasting, pricing analytics, procurement analytics, or market intelligence Demonstrated leadership experience managing teams of 10-15 members in a high‑intensity delivery environment Proven ability to run a function end‑to‑end—strategy, execution, stakeholder management, governance, and delivery assurance Strong exposure to commodity markets across chemicals, polymers, energy, metals, agriculture, packaging, and industrial inputs Core Technical Skills Forecasting: time‑series models, driver/regression models, econometric frameworks Statistical: model validation, back‑testing, error measurement, bias detection Data proficiency: SQL, large structured datasets, data quality processes, automation frameworks Fundamental analysis: Supply-demand analysis, impact of geopolitical tensions and conflicts, natural disasters, etc. on commodities Leadership & Behavioral Competencies Take full accountability for priorities, anticipate risks proactively, and deliver consistently with minimal supervision Effectively delegate, train team members, drive accountability, and resolve conflicts with sound judgment and professionalism Articulate insights in a concise, structured, and outcome‑focused manner suitable for senior stakeholders and decision-makers Convert complex problems into clear drivers, actionable insights, and well‑defined recommendations Build consensus across diverse teams, negotiate scope and priorities, and drive adoption of forecasting outputs and strategic decisions Manage team’s performance and appraisal processes end-to-end

title: Senior Analyst - In directs- Analytics Solutions
jobDescription:
Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Analyst with expertise in indirect spend categories and inflation forecasting to join our Analytics Solution team. The ideal candidate will specialize in building forecasts across key indirect categories such as MRO, facilities management, IT services, professional services, and others. This role requires close collaboration with client procurement teams and internal stakeholders to deliver accurate, timely, and data-driven insights that support strategic sourcing and cost-management initiatives. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop and maintain robust inflation and price-forecasting models for indirect categories using statistical, cost model and market intelligence techniques Analyze macroeconomic indicators, supplier cost structures, industry indices, labor market trends, and input cost drivers impacting indirect spend inflation Build and validate cost breakdown models for indirect categories to identify key cost drivers and assess volatility and risk exposure Prepare and deliver clear, concise inflation outlook reports, dashboards, and presentations for clients Support custom forecasting requests and ensure high-quality, on-time delivery of client outputs Category Expertise: Conduct in-depth research and market analysis across indirect categories – professional services, facilities management, MRO, IT services etc Monitor market movements, supplier dynamics, capacity trends, regulatory changes, and industry cost structures affecting indirect spend Analyze category-specific inflation levers such as labor cost trends, energy price fluctuations, transportation rate movements, and service-based cost drivers to enhance forecast accuracy Evaluate supplier pricing models and index linkages across indirect categories to understand margin structures and benchmarking opportunities Technical Skills: Strong knowledge of Statistical Data Analysis, Forecasting and Statistical Modelling Experience in creating and testing category forecasting frameworks for indirect spend, leveraging market inputs, supplier economics, and external indices to validate assumptions and ensure accuracy Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel and data visualization tools (Power BI/Tableau) Qualifications & Skills: Master’s degree in economics, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field. 2-3 years of experience in inflation analysis, price forecasting, cost modeling, or procurement analytics—preferably focused on indirect spend categories. Experience working with large datasets, industry indices, and procurement cost structures Strong communication skills with the ability to simplify technical insights for non-technical stakeholders. Detail-oriented, strong problem-solving mindset, and ability to manage multiple priorities under tight timelines. title: AI Engineer (Agentic AI & LLM Systems)
jobDescription:
We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to join our growing AI team. You’ll play a key role in developing intelligent, agentic AI systems using cutting-edge large language models (LLMs), multi-agent orchestration, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). This is a hands-on role combining software engineering, ML/NLP expertise, and a passion for building next-gen autonomous agents. You’ll collaborate closely with AI leads, backend engineers, data engineers, and product managers to bring scalable and intelligent systems to life—integrated into real-world procurement and business applications. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design and implement agentic AI pipelines using Lang Graph, Lang Chain, Crew AI, or custom frameworks. Build robust retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems with vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Open Search) Fine-tune, evaluate, and deploy LLMs for task-specific applications. Integrate external tools and APIs into multi-agent workflows using dynamic tool/function calling (e.g., Open AI JSON schema) Develop memory modules such as short-term context, episodic memory, and long term vector stores. Build scalable, cloud-native services using Python, Docker, and Terraform. Monitor and evaluate agent performance using tailored metrics (e.g., success rate, hallucination rate). Ensure secure, reliable, and maintainable deployment of AI systems in production environments. Your profile: 7+ years of professional experience in machine learning, NLP, or software engineering. Strong proficiency in Python and experience with ML libraries like Py Torch, Tensor Flow, scikit-learn, and XGBoost Hands-on experience with LLMs (e.g., GPT, Claude, LLa MA, Mistral) and NLP tooling such as Lang Chain, Hugging Face, and Transformers. Experience designing and implementing RAG pipelines with chunking, semantic search, and reranking. Familiarity with agent frameworks and orchestration techniques (e.g., planning, memory, role assignment). Deep understanding of prompt engineering, embeddings, and LLM architecture basics. Design systems with role-based communication, coordination loops, and hierarchical planning. Optimize agent collaboration strategies for real-world tasks. Solid foundation in microservice architectures, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform). Experience integrating REST/Graph QL APIs into ML workflows. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with a builder’s mindset and willingness to explore new approaches. Bonus Qualifications Experience with RLHF, Lo RA, or parameter-efficient LLM fine-tuning. Familiarity with Crew AI, Auto Gen, Swarm, or other multi-agent libraries. Exposure to cognitive architectures like task trees, state machines, or episodic memory. Prompt debugging and LLM evaluation practices. Awareness of AI security risks (e.g., prompt injection, data exposure).

title: QA Engineer – Automation & Agentic Applications
jobDescription: We are looking for a QA Engineer with strong automation expertise and experience testing intelligent/agentic applications to join our growing engineering team. You will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, safety, and reliability of our platform by developing automated test. frameworks, validating agent autonomy and decision-making, and collaborating closely with developers, product owners, and Dev Ops. This role goes beyond traditional QA: you will be working with AI-driven, agentic applications that can plan, act, and adapt. Your job will be to make sure they behave correctly, safely, and predictably under real-world conditions. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and test scripts using Python. Write and execute manual and automated test cases to validate product features, agent behavior, and functionality. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous quality and fast feedback. Collaborate with developers and product managers to identify, reproduce, and resolve defects early in the lifecycle. Define and document test plans, strategies, and acceptance criteria for both deterministic and agentic features. Perform scenario-based, exploratory, and chaos testing to validate agent decision making under uncertainty, failure, and edge conditions. Verify observability and explainability of agent behavior (logs, traces, intermediate actions) to ensure compliance, transparency, and auditability. Test human-in-the-loop workflows, ensuring proper escalation, overrides, and user safety. Conduct root cause analysis of production issues, including agent misbehavior, and contribute to long-term fixes. Contribute to the development and enforcement of QA standards and best practices. Must-Have Qualifications 5+ years of experience in QA Engineering with a focus on test automation. Proficient in Python for writing test scripts and tools. Hands-on experience with testing frameworks such as Pytest, Selenium, or Playwright. Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, including unit, integration, system, and end-to-end testing. Familiarity with REST APIs and tools like Postman, Swagger, or Bruno for API testing Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to think beyond “happy path” testing. Nice-to-Have Qualifications Experience testing agentic or AI-driven applications (e.g., autonomous decision making, multi-step workflows) Experience with scenario-based or chaos testing frameworks Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools (e.g., Datadog, Grafana, AWS Cloud Watch) to validate agent behavior Experience testing microservices Experience with CI/CD tools like Git Hub Actions, Jenkins, or Git Lab CI Knowledge of security and guardrail testing (role-based access, safe action validation)

title: AI Developer
jobDescription:
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop and train machine learning models to address key business challenges. Integrate AI functionalities into existing and new software applications. Continuously evaluate and improve the performance of existing AI models. Collaborate with product and engineering teams to define solution requirements and customize AI features. Document all phases of AI development from model design to deployment. Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field; Master’s preferred. At least 3 years of experience in AI development or machine learning projects. Strong programming skills in Python, and familiarity with AI libraries such as Tensor Flow, Py Torch, and Scikit-learn. Experience with data management and data-driven decision making. Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities. Effective communication skills, capable of presenting complex technical details to non-technical stakeholders. Experience in deploying AI solutions in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). Practical knowledge of software development practices and Dev Ops tools. Prior work in an Agile development environment. To submit your application or to enquire about this role, please email your application to kommi.ramesh@beroe-inc.com .
